2. Reason: The Planner incorrectly identified Princess Margaretha of Saxony’s mother as Archduchess Luise of Austria-Tuscany. The prior search result (Wikipedia snippet) clearly shows her mother was Princess Amalie Auguste of Bavaria (for the 1840–1858 Margaretha). The Planner conflated two different Princess Margaretha/Margarete of Saxony (the 1900–1962 one is the daughter of Luise of Austria-Tuscany). This misidentification would lead subsequent steps to research the wrong person’s birthplace.
